name: M9 minimal + 0.2% glucose + Sigma set of 9 amino acids (DEILVFHST) (PMC7064777)
description: M9 minimal + 0.2% glucose + Sigma set of 9 amino acids (DEILVFHST) — medium reported in PMC7064777 (complex/undefined base — extracts not BiGG-mappable).

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC7064777 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Complex medium: chemically-defined portion mapped to BiGG; biological extracts listed in `unmapped`. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.base_expansion: Base 'M9' expanded to standard composition: M9 minimal medium (Sambrook & Russell 2001): Na2HPO4, KH2PO4, NaCl, NH4Cl, MgSO4, CaCl2 + carbon source.
provenance.verification_evidence: Paper Methods: "M9 medium plus 0.2% glucose" and "The addition of 9 amino acids (DEILVFHST), known as the Σ set, allows balanced exponential growth of (p)ppGpp0 strains." Aerobic: "Two independent cultures (25 ml in 125-ml flasks)...were grown with aeration at 37°C."
